text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After training...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"My senses feel remarkably sharp today... 
I still feel like I have energy to 
spare...!"
choice_data_list:
In that case, how about some extra 
training?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! Thank you very much! 
I want to push myself to the limit!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—I had an inkling it would come to this. 
At her strong request, her extra training 
was to 
take place in the mountains.
choice_data_list: Trail running is fine with you, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes...!
choice_data_list:
Be very careful, okay? I'll be waiting at 
the goal!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...About that, actually—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Would you mind letting me 
carry you on my back, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I really am in top form today— 
regular running just won't be enough."
choice_data_list:
But you just finished your regular 
training!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"No! This isn't overconfidence, I can do 
it! 
I need the resistance. For that purpose, 
won't you please let me carry you?"
choice_data_list:
...Just don't push yourself too hard, 
okay?

...Just don't push yourself too hard, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I climbed onto Daring Tact's back. 
And the very next second—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Flying. Flying. We're flying—! 
Every shade of green rushes before my 
eyes, 
cleaving open to the left and right!
choice_data_list: Whoaaaaaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I'm just... getting started—!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With every stride she plants, vibrations 
surge up. 
As if refusing to leave a single drop of 
energy behind. 
Vibrations slamming her entire self into 
the mountain!
choice_data_list: Eeeeeeek—!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking of recharging my energy 
for our next training session... 
Would you care to join me?"
choice_data_list: If so, I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She led me deep into the mountains. 
With deft hands, Daring Tact swiftly 
assembled 
a makeshift cooking area.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...All right! 
Let's get started right away!"
choice_data_list: Ooh, nice!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I've prepared the ingredients here. 
We'll use wild mountain greens, river 
fish, and some 
vegetables I brought to make foil-wrapped 
bakes."
choice_data_list: You're handling that like a TV chef...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, thank you. 
First, to make the river fish easier to 
eat, 
we remove the gills and entrails."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Then sprinkle with salt... 
wrap it in foil together with the mountain 
greens, 
and preparation is complete!"
choice_data_list:
A meal that lets the natural flavors 
shine!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, elaborate dishes are delicious too, 
but... 
when cooking in the wild, I feel that 
letting the 
ingredients speak for themselves is best."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Next, we put the rice over the fire... 
Trainer, could you keep an eye on it?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I'll make something else in the meantime.
choice_data_list: Sure thing! What are you making next?
Sure thing! What are you making next?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: A table and chairs.
choice_data_list: ...Wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"After all, having them makes all the 
difference 
in comfort. I noticed some fallen logs 
that looked 
just right a moment ago."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—The resounding clops of woodcutting echo 
out. 
Before me, the mess tin bubbles and 
rattles, while 
the faint sizzle of roasting river fish 
drifts by.
choice_data_list:
...Those natural flavors really are 
shining through...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It's ready, Trainer! 
Yours looks to be done as well, so 
let's eat!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, today... 
Daring Tact doesn't seem to be in peak 
condition.
choice_data_list: Make sure to get plenty of rest, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...I think I'll go somewhere else 
to get some rest."
choice_data_list: ...Meaning?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Would you like to come along, 
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Around here should be good... 
There we go."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She brought me deep into the mountains. 
Surrounded by stands of trees, 
Daring Tact set down her pack.
choice_data_list: You mean you're resting here?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, though rather than just resting... 
I was thinking of sleeping here for a 
bit."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke, she pulled a large sheet 
from her pack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She tied the four corners to nearby trees, 
creating a canopy over the sleeping area.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Just having a roof makes sleeping 
so much easier, you know."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A mat and sleeping bag were laid atop the 
grass. 
Indeed, this looked like a cozy place to 
sleep.
choice_data_list:
Does sleeping in the mountains really make 
that much difference?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. 
If you experience it with me, 
I'm sure you'll understand its charm."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Here, please.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Doing as told, I slipped into the 
sleeping bag 
under the canopy of sheet and lay down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sleeping in an open space with no walls 
around 
felt strangely surreal.
choice_data_list:
(Still, this mountain breeze... feels so 
cool and nice...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Zzz... zzz...
choice_data_list: (...She's already asleep.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Listening to her peaceful breathing, my 
consciousness 
gradually drifted away... 
Before I knew it, I was wrapped in the 
rustle of leaves.
choice_data_list: (...I get it now. This feels wonderful.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Nothing compares to the mountains 
after all. 
Both my body and mind feel completely at 
peace."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. 
I look forward to working with you 
tomorrow as well!"

title: Nothing at All, Everything at Once!
